about_the_game:
Core Hustlers is a single-player sci-fi extraction shooter that fuses high-stakes survival with a living narrative. You’ll infiltrate derelict stations, hack corrupted data cores, and fight your way through shifting, procedural environments where every run is unique — and deadly.

This isn’t a scripted ride. Story and gameplay are woven seamlessly together: Voss and his sharp-tongued copilot Nika banter, argue, and reveal the plot as you play, not in immersion-breaking cutscenes. Their feud with the Syndicates unfolds organically while you scavenge, craft, and survive in the Rim Galaxy.

Enemies think, flank, and punish hesitation. Ships themselves are part of the danger — full of traps, collapsing layouts, and environment-driven puzzles that escalate the deeper you go. The risks rise with every deck you descend, but so do the rewards. Loot progression, crafting, and a persistent hacker’s toolkit tie every run back to your core role: breaking into forbidden systems and extracting their secrets.

You’re not a soldier. You’re a hustler with a busted ship and one rule: don’t f*ck up. Out here, every mistake can be your last.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
